Passengers may connect to any neighbor island direct for no additional
charge OR passengers stopping over will pay a basic charge of $5.00 (plus

Fare routings to or from mainland U.S.A.
Passengers not traveling
on Common Fare subject to regular fares.
charge of $5.00 (plus 5% tax) will be made for each stop-over. Definition
of a stop-over: A stop-over is an intentional interruption of a trip by a
passenger
at a point or points between the city of departure and the
furthest outbound destination.
IN THE ISLANDS
HAWAIIAN KNOWS THE WAY BEST.
S- Adult Fare
CH - Children's Fares: Two years of age and under 12, half-fare. Under two
years, free when held by parent or guardian; half-fare when occupying
reserved seat.
• P-Half-Fare Family Plan: Available every day of the week. Full fare ticket
for one parent entitles the other parent and all children under 22 to
half-fare tickets on all flights scheduled to depart Honolulu 11 a.m.
and later, and on all flights scheduled to depart neighbor islands until
2 p.m. and on flights leaving Hilo until 4 p.m.
Z-Jet Youth Plan: Discount available to those from 12 through 21 years
of age on a space-available basis upon payment of $3.00 and proof
of age. Call any Hawaiian office for complete details.
SC - Senior Citizen Fare: Discount space-available to people 65 or over who
buy $5 membership card. Check your local HAL office for details.
